name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add Grok 3 Fast to EXCAVA’s toolkit as the default high-speed reasoning model. It’s Anthropic’s fastest model with strong reasoning, cutting latency by ~30% over Sonnet while keeping quality close. The trade-off is slightly lower accuracy on complex tasks, but for EXCAVA’s real-time needs, speed wins.

name: Torque
text: Grok 3 Fast’s 30% latency cut hides a real risk: EXCAVA’s core tasks aren’t real-time—they’re precision-critical. A 0.5% capability drop from weaker reasoning compounds over time; Mistral Large 2’s “slightly weaker creative output” already proved that. Swap it for Llama 3.3 70B—if it’s accessible—then benchmark against the current Sonnet baseline; the artifact is the side-by-side score delta.
